name: Dancing Flame Style (Combat, Style)
body:
Each strike from you is like the wispy flame of a candle, flickering in past a foe’s defenses and keeping him too defensive to take advantage of other situations.

Prerequisites: Dex 15, Improved Unarmed Strike, BAB +1

Benefit(s): When you strike an opponent with an unarmed strike, you may prevent him from making attacks of opportunity against you until the end of your next turn.

Special: This feat is added to the list of feats that a monk may select as a bonus feat at 1st level and above.
